In shallow lakes, ﬁsh were collected with a seine (25 m long, 1·5 m highand 5 mm mesh size) or by means of a 24 V d.c. backpack electroﬁshing unit (model 12-BSmith-Root, Inc.; www.smith-root.com). Individuals were killed by an overdose of benzocaineand ﬁxed with 4% formaldehyde

Individuals were killed by an overdose of benzocaineand ﬁxed with 4% formaldehyde
